company.name: Harbor Workspace
company.mission: To give freelancers and growing teams a professional place to work, connect, and thrive.
company.vision: To be Greater Manchester's most trusted flexible workspace for SMEs.
company.businessDescription: Harbor Workspace provides private offices, hot desks, and meeting rooms for freelancers and SMEs. We focus on professional environments, reliable Wi-Fi, and friendly on-site support.
company.serviceArea: Greater Manchester and remote members (virtual desk plan)

products.name: Hot Desk
products.description: Flexible shared desk access in our open workspace area.
products.availableColours: N/A — workspace service (not a physical product)
products.warranty: N/A — membership service; see policies for cancellation terms.
products.deliveryInformation: Access starts on your membership start date. No shipping required.

products.name: Dedicated Desk
products.description: Your own fixed desk with locker and mail handling.
products.deliveryInformation: Desk assigned on move-in day after setup fee is paid.

products.name: Private Office
products.description: Lockable furnished office for teams of 2–12.
products.deliveryInformation: Office handover scheduled after contract signing.

pricing.discounts: 2 months free when Hot Desk or Dedicated Desk is paid annually.

general.a: Flexible workspace — hot desks, dedicated desks, private offices, and meeting rooms in Manchester.

general.q: Can I visit before signing up?
general.a: Yes. Book a free tour through Reception.

faqs.shipping: We are a local workspace — there is no product shipping. Virtual Desk mail handling is collected on-site or forwarded per your plan.
faqs.returns: Membership cancellations follow our refund policy in policies.md. No returns apply to workspace services.
faqs.delivery: Membership access begins on your start date. Meeting rooms and tours are booked by appointment.
faqs.payments: We accept card, bank transfer, and direct debit. VAT is added at checkout. Invoices are sent monthly or annually.
faqs.support: Contact hello@harborworkspace.example or call +44 161 555 0100. Reception handles first contact; complex issues escalate to a manager.

policies.refundPolicy: No refund for partial months already started. Prepaid annual plans: pro-rata refund minus used months and setup fee.
policies.privacyPolicy: Customer conversation data is used for service only unless marketing consent is given. Do not share other members' information.
policies.warranty: Workspace services are membership-based, not product warranties. Service issues are resolved by on-site support.
policies.returns: Month-to-month plans: 30 days' written notice. Private Office: cannot cancel before minimum term; then 30 days' notice.
